description.value: Hello! I used to work at the Internet Archive on the Open Library project. I also made [a group on Flickr][3] just in case you enjoy taking photos of books. There's a natty way to join Flickr photos with Open Library books, you see. Now I own my own business called Good, Form & Spectacle, which specialises in digital and product design for cultural heritage endeavours. ###Some Favourite Authors### [Iris Murdoch][4], [Dorothy Parker][5], [Roald Dahl][6], [Sylvia Plath][7], [Jeffrey Eugenides][8], [Alberto Manguel][9], [Janet Frame][10], [Franz Kafka][11], [Angela Carter][12], [Brothers Grimm][13], [Douglas Coupland][14], [Peter Carey][15], [Hubert Selby][16], [Martin Amis][17], [Jorge Luis Borges][18], [Aimee Bender][19] and [Alain de Botton][20]. ###Some Favourite Books### The Magic Faraway Tree, Amelia Bedelia, Sula, The Colour Purple, The Very Long Dog, [In Me Own Words: The Autobiography of Bigfoot][21], The Odyssey, Girlfriend in a Coma, The Lovely Bones, The Colony of Unrequited Dreams.
